profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at UBS
profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: As a software developer, love to grasp any opportunity to make myself better and keep learning the new skills to catch modern. love challenges since it's the best way to evolve. Life is hopeful(Never Give Up)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivery of innovative WMA applications to enhance client advisory services.
• Designed and developed enterprise-grade agentic AI workflow, enabling autonomous task orchestration, multi-step reasoning.
• Architected and built RAG System, integrating heterogeneous data sources, and unstructured document repositories to deliver context-aware, explainable AI responses.
• Implemented hybrid search (vector + keyword) using FAISS and BM25, reducing hallucination rates by 40%.
• Built MCP-compliant tool interfaces to safely interact with databases, file systems, APIs, and internal services.
• Design of a caching solution that accelerated database read operations by 100×, standardizing high-
performance data access across applications
• Engineered and built applications based on Micro-service and Micro-frontend architectures, ensuring
modularity and scalability.
• Spearheaded the modernization of legacy on-premises applications to cloud-native, AI-ready architectures, significantly improving efficiency and scalability.
• Engineered a micro-frontend application leveraging React, Web Components, and Lerna for optimized
performance and scalability.
• Built end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for React, Java, Python, and Node.js services, integrating automated testing, artifact management, and deployment orchestration.
positions.insights: Skills: Cache Management · OpenAI API · Spring Cloud · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Elasticsearch · LangChain · Data Modeling · LangGraph · Maven · System Architecture

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked closely with software architects, analyzed requirement for projects and issues.
•	Worked closely with system administrators to configure application environment.
•	Developed UI using HTML5, CSS3, Twitter Bootstrap & Object oriented JavaScript.
•	Remediated applications from PHP 4.4 to PHP 5.3. Migrated applications from Apache to Zend Server.
•	Developed PHP applications in MVC based framework.
•	Utilized DB2 and MySQL databases.
•	Wrote database queries in SQL for features like premium discounts and case enrollment.
•	Developed Unit Testing with PHPUnit.
•	Developed automated testing with Selenium WebDriver.
•	Exposure to JAVA & Node.js web services.
•	Utilized Git & Dimensions as version control, Serena Business Manager as issuing tracking.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Maintained and Improved Internal System in Full stack environment with Agile methodology.
•	Developed different reports based on database metadata using Kohana_3 and ExtJs_4.
•	Developed PHP Script to search by path and used by multiple-place code Modification.
•	Implemented report validation insert and modify feature to prevent Malicious and Reduplicates input.
•	Developed onboarding module which assist new developer to familiar system quicker using bootstrap_3, Jquery, and PHP_5.x.
•	Developed scheduled script to insert data into Oracle Database safety.
•	Developed bash-script to store some useful command which using during development.
•	Fixed bugs existed at Internal system both front-end side and back-end side.
•	Qualified all queries existing at this Internal System.
•	Collaborate with and assist team members and QA/UAT testers.
•	Participate in Deployment for each release and testing during at that time.

positions.title: web developer
positions.description:
• Responsibilities included development of administrator site and visitor site.
• Designing and implementing new features and functionality.
• Establishing and guiding the website’s architecture.
• Ensuring high-performance and availability, and managing all technical aspects of the site.
• Formulate an effective, responsive design and truing it into templates.
• Daily resolved any unexpected bugs existed on the site.

projects.title: Web Application
projects.description:
• Collected and mapped data from various clients by communicating with clients. 
  • Created Analyzed System to predict how long a process will take by utilizing data and related algorithm.
  • Selected the “Champion” of client by Prediction and display his/her status for future work.
  • Updated customer information and status once database was updated.

projects.title: Enterprise Software Architecture and Design
projects.description:
.Implemented enterprise software system based on Web Services and cloud computing Technology
.Utilized architecture such as service-oriented, event-driven and representational state transfer 
.Built and installed the application EARs in the development environment and deploy it into glassfish server
